history.administration_response: The Administration considers this recommendation to be implemented, given that standard unit requirements were addressed during the memorandum of understanding negotiation process. history.sg_progress: The Department of Operational Support will initiate a project, by the third quarter of 2026, to rationalize the holding of contingent-owned equipment generators across all deployed missions. In line with the Contingent-Owned Equipment Manual, the Department will review generator requirements and address unnecessary overcapacity. This initiative will directly support the review of standard unit requirements in accordance with the recommendation and contribute to a cross- cutting approach to mitigating energy overproduction within contingents in accordance with the recommendation in paragraph 175 of the current report of the Board (A/80/5 (Vol. II)).
